Drag, or use the arrow keys.

particlefilter.diagnostic.here_line.tool: Switching on Here makes a zone for each source of that particle: the spots where it spawned during this diagnostic, grouped when they're within the distance set below of each other, directly or through spots in between. Up to %s zones per particle, for its busiest sources. Zones that overlap by at least the share set below merge into one box around both. Zones keep adjusting as you switch particles on and off or change either setting, until you move or resize one yourself. Each side is at most %s blocks; a source spread wider is only partly covered, so consider Everywhere for it.

particlefilter.guide.title: Quick start
particlefilter.guide.scan.title: Find the particles
particlefilter.guide.scan.body: Look at where the unwanted particles come from and press Scan. Every particle that appears within 6 blocks during the scan is listed, most frequent first, so you don't need to know any names. Set how long it records next to "Scan for".
particlefilter.guide.hide.title: Hide them
particlefilter.guide.hide.body: Switch on Everywhere to hide a particle in every world, or Here to hide it only in a zone around the scanned spot. The line under the list says which zone Here uses. If there's none yet, the first particle you switch on creates one, sized to fit where the particles appeared. Use New zone to make a separate zone even inside an existing one. If particles you switched on also appeared outside the zone, Grow to fit offers to enlarge it to cover them.
particlefilter.guide.diagnostic.title: Diagnostic scan
particlefilter.guide.diagnostic.body: The Diagnostic page (or /particles diagnostic) records every particle around you, split into those still appearing and those your rules already hide, so you can find what's left. Here gives each source of a particle its own fitted zone (spots within the distance set at the bottom count as one source), and zones overlapping by at least the share set there merge; if a zone you already have hides a particle that still appears just outside it, Grow to fit offers to enlarge that zone instead. Minecraft usually doesn't create particles more than 32 blocks from you, so farther ones won't show up.
particlefilter.guide.hidden.title: Hidden page
particlefilter.guide.hidden.body: Everything you've hidden, and where. Switch an entry off to see the particle again without losing it; Delete removes it. You can also type a particle ID, or hide a block's breaking and mining particles.
particlefilter.guide.zones.title: Zones
particlefilter.guide.zones.body: Each zone has its own outline color, shown while this menu is open. Edit a zone to move or resize it; Side 1 and Side 2 are labelled with the way they run from where you face.
particlefilter.guide.rules.title: Active rules
particlefilter.guide.rules.body: The switch at the bottom left pauses some or all of your rules at once, to compare with and without them. Nothing is deleted.
particlefilter.guide.keys.title: Keys
particlefilter.guide.keys.body: Keys to open this menu, scan, hide the targeted block's breaking particles, show zone outlines, cycle Active rules and hold to show every particle can be set in Options → Controls → Key Binds. They start unbound.
